lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, forming a semi-regular grid pattern on the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs to form visible grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by sharp vertical gradients with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense distribution of high-luminance spots covering the entire dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, decreasing in size toward the distal edge.
